name: RC-B10-0201/2026 – After § 5 – Am 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on ensuring accountability and justice in response to Russia’s continued attacks against the civilian population in Ukraine
part_text: 5a. Calls for the EU to urgently scale up its diplomatic engagement and prioritise genuine political dialogue over a predominantly military-driven approach, with the aim of achieving an immediate ceasefire and a just and lasting peace; deplores the lack of alternative diplomatic and peaceful initiatives taken by the EU, as well as its dependence on external actors; stresses that the EU must place conflict prevention, de-escalation and the protection of civilians at the core of its external action and actively promote inclusive and credible diplomatic initiatives;
